state.case_summary:
A man in his 20s presented with complaints of intermittent palpitations for 2 days, which had worsened in the previous hour. He had no history of chest pain, dyspnea, congestion, or fever. There was no past cardiac history or family history of similar complaints.

Blood pressure was 110/72 mm Hg, respiratory rate was 14 bpm. Cardiovascular system examination results were unremarkable.

- ECG Studies:    Image A Title: Initial ECG    Image A Description: Wide complex tachycardia at rate of 190 bpm with atypical left bundle branch morphology (QS in leads V1-V5 with transition in V6), QRS duration of 146 ms with no evidence of AV dissociation, and inferior axis.        Image B Title: Post-treatment ECG    Image B Description: Normal sinus rhythm at 64 bpm with normal QRS axis. Precordial T-wave inversion in leads V1 to V5, I, and aVL. Epsilon wave present in lead V4 and low voltage in limb leads.  - Echocardiography:    Global hypokinesia of right ventricle, dilated RV, ballooned out RVOT measuring 35 mm with tricuspid annular plane systolic excursion of 17 mm.      - Cardiac MRI:    Findings: Grossly dilated RV, high RV end diastolic volume of 219.9 mL, RVOT diameter of 31 mm, RV ejection fraction of 19.3%. Postcontrast hyperenhancement along RV free wall, RVOT apical wall, RV aspect of septum, and in basal inferior, midcavity inferior, and inferoseptal myocardium of left ventricle.

root.label: Acute Palpitations Syndrome with Wide Complex Tachycardia and RV Dysfunction
supporting_facts: echocardiography showing global hypokinesia of right ventricle
cardiac MRI showing grossly dilated RV and high RV end diastolic volume
excluded_candidates: Competing mechanism: Ischemic heart disease - unlikely given the patient's age and lack of cardiac history
Competing mechanism: Inflammatory heart disease - possible but less likely given the absence of fever or other systemic symptoms
alarm_features: palpitations worsened in the previous hour
salient_findings: wide complex tachycardia at rate of 190 bpm
postcontrast hyperenhancement along RV free wall
